packageRules.description: In-repo libraries must hold the same version in every module. ci.yml does not check that; a split is only visible as a build failure somewhere else, so keep each bump to a single PR that moves all nine go.mod files together rather than nine PRs that land at nine different times.
Everything else in Go, one PR per dependency, matching the cadence the per-service dependabot configs used before the consolidation dropped them.
Actions as one grouped PR, as the per-service dependabot configs did.

Images the stack pulls rather than builds. Pinning them by digest is the point of this config: without it a CI result is a function of the registry as well as the commit, so an old commit re-run later can go red with nothing to bisect. The tag is kept alongside the digest so the file still says what it is running.

customManagers.description: MinIO is referenced from Go as well as from compose: two testutil constants and the piri compose generator, whose output is gitignored and so has no file for the docker-compose manager to read. Scoped to the minio image by name, which deliberately leaves smelt/pkg/stack/options.go alone - the six ghcr.io/fil-forge/<service>:main references there are the published peers an itest run is meant to be tested against, and pinning those would turn that compatibility check into a slower copy of e2e.
